tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam rgyal ma'i sbyin sreg 'chi med 'od 'bar bzhugs so// swa sti bi dza ya/ rnam par rgyal ma'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung zhing kha skong ba dang / sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sa dkar dang tsandan bzang po sogs dri bzang gis byugs pa'i gzhi la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa'i dbus nas khru phyed zlum bskor gyi nang padma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir sor bzhi zlum bskor gnyis kyi kha khyer mu ran gnyis byas pa'i mu ran la rdor phreng ser po/ de'i sor bzhi gru bzhi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ de'i phyir sor do gru bzhi rnams byas pa'i thab nang gi pad lder sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i rgyab g.yas g.yon gnyis su bum pa re re/ mdun gyi g.yas su pad dkar/ g.yon du utpal la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du ral gri/ lhor lcags kyu/ nub tu dbyug sngon/ byang du rtse gsum rnams 'bri ba'o/ /yang na thams cad nas 'bras gang rung gi tshom bu'am/ tshon spungs lha'i kha dog dang mthun par byas kyang chog kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing zlum po tho gang gi dpang brtsigs pa'i/ shar lho'i mtshams su me tshang ting lo bzhag thab kyi zhal nub tu phyogs par byas pa'i mdun du sgrub pa po'i stan dang bsang chu/ rdor dril/ dgang blugs/ me yol dkar rtsis byugs te ti se'i gangs su bsgom/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas nas yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / 'bras dang so ba nas sran ma/ /gro dang dur wa ku sha ste/ /g.yon nas chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ /'das gtor cha gsum gtor ma dang / /me lha'i gtor ma rim bzhin bshams/ /snga dro'i phyi dro'i dus su khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar po bya/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par bya/

a mṛ ta nyer gcig gis bsangs/ chu byin gyis brlabs/ rdzas rnams la gtor te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ yam shing rtse la ras mar sbags pa'i lce lde la me sbar te/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing / thab la g.yas nas lan gsum bskor te/ me tshang du gzhug rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas me sbar la/ bsangs sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar bskyed la/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra pa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /oṃ agna ya ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sa da ka ka ru ṇya kṛ ta sarba artha/ asmin sanni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul la/ thab kyi dbus su padma dang ra skyes kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ me lha sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ thab dang yo byad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bskyed la/

oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /des bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swāhā/ zhes dang / oṃ badzra sa twa a/ zhes pas thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas bskor du dbul/ me lha'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas/ dgang blugs kyi raṃ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis mthar/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la/ oṃ agna ye/ ā dī pyā/ ā dī pyā/ ā bi ṣa/ ā biṣa/ ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya/ ba ha nā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ oṃ agna ye sa pā ri wā ra/ zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pas steng nas blang zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul te/ de yang / oṃ bo dhi brikṣa ya swāhā/ yam shing / oṃ agna ye swāhā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya swāhā/ til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zas mchog oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra bi dzā ya swāhā/ so ba/ oṃ badzra be gā ya swāhā/ nas/ oṃ badzra ma hā ba la ya swāhā/ sran ma/ oṃ ghasma rā ya swāhā/ gro/ oṃ badzra ā yuḥṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ ku sha rnams nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pas phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ mar blugs gzur gang thab tu blug ste/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/

slar yang me bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su paṃ las sogs nas lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar gyi lha bskyed/ nye snying sngon 'gro'i byon skyems lan gsum gong ltar phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra re re sngon du 'gro bas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyis bstod/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams brgya re 'bul/ rdzas sngags oṃ bo dhi brikṣa la sogs pa rnams gsum tsam re sngon du btang nas/ nus na gzungs ring mi nus na nye snying gis phul/ spel tshig brgya re'i mjug tu/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bsreg rdzas thams cad ma 'byor na yam shing mar til tsam gyis chog bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i til 'bul/ slar yang gong byon skyems ltar dgang blugs gsum dang / mchod pa kha gsos te mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/ de nas cha gsum btang / yig brgya ci nus dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ thab kyi rdul cung zad dpral bar bkus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams ci rigs phul/ byon skyems ltar gshegs skyems phul/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ agna ye sa pā ri wā ra zhes pa'i mthar/

nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas phul/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrub kyin bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes brjod cing dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du phyir bskyed la/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung ste/ dge ba bsngo zhing / bkra shis byas la/ yo byad rnams bsdus te me mnal ba na/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung la sogs par dor ro/ /de ltar thun gnyis gsum bzhi bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha'i kha skong rnams 'grig bar bya/ grol mtshams snga dro la bya/ mthar thal ba rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor ba sogs bya'o/ /rgyas pa la sogs pa rnams kyang de dang de'i bsam pa dang ldan pas/ de dang de'i khyad par gyi rdzas rnams dang thab la sogs pa spyi 'gre ltar shes par bya zhing / phan yon sogs gzungs dang rtogs pa/ de'i ṭi ka rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa dang / rnam rgyal rnam bshad mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa sogs la zhib tu blta'o/ /zhes gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gyi sbyin sreg gi tho yig 'chi med 'od 'bar zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg dang / mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi rnam rgyal sbyin sreg gnyis phan tshun spyir btang dmigs bsal spel sbyar du bsdebs pa dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rnam rgyal ma'i sbyin sreg 'chi med 'od 'bar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
